name: Sugimoto Satoshi
source:
University Professor.
Teacher in charge of the seminar that the protagonist attends.
He has a kind smile and a soft way of speaking, but he isn't afraid to speak frankly.
He's helping the protagonist collect data on "uniformed old men". His subject is social studies.
